items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: That was Belle Melençon and them, Jean Fourjeau and them, Dr. Fourjeau and all of them. They used to have, oh they had a wonderful band

ctx.x: Were there any white musicians that were involved studying with Mr. Kerry and someone like this? Or did he just, he worked entirely with the Negro people? That's right. That's right. That's perfectly amazing. That's right.

Because they had only one band here that was really playing music then, that was the Brobridge band. Yeah. That was Belle Melençon and them, Jean Fourjeau and them, Dr. Fourjeau and all of them. They used to have, oh they had a wonderful band, but that was a regular brass band. But they used to use a few pieces and go around playing like that during the time they had election and things like that. But they had a good band.
How did the alto parts go in that time when you first started?
